description: Canonical MCP/tool registry for Dikte. Servers are declared once here; client-specific config (.mcp.json for Claude Code, native config elsewhere) is generated or hand-derived from this file. Credentials are environment-variable references only - never literal values.

graphify.notes: Primary structural memory. Not exposed as an MCP server here because every agent can invoke the CLI directly; keep it that way unless a client cannot run CLIs.

context7.decision: Deferred 2026-08-25: Dikte's stack (PyQt6, stdlib, whisper.cpp) changes slowly; adds an always-available network dependency to a privacy-first local tool. Revisit if docs drift causes repeated mistakes.

serena.decision: Rejected 2026-08-25: codebase navigation/memory overlaps Graphify's responsibility; running two persistent context systems invites conflicts. Reconsider only if precise LSP refactor operations become a proven bottleneck.

rules: Never place API keys or tokens in this file; use environment references only.
Do not enable two servers for the same responsibility.
Inspect install scripts before running them; pin versions where practical.
